acceptanceCriteriaMapping.note: The authoritative doc has two separate numbered lists: numbered sections (1-24) and the 'Acceptance Criteria' list (1-20). References here mean the Acceptance Criteria list unless they say 'section'. dailyProofCycleCompletion is the daily-proof test-project cycle (section 3) demonstrated end to end as ONE controlled cycle: Spec 147 -> 145 -> 141 -> 146 -> 144 -> 142/138 -> ADOS execution -> independent Codex reviewer resolved from the run's own durable implementer id -> real ADOS run-level completion reflected by the office -> task 'completed' via the existing operator transition (criteria 1-17; office lifecycle section 12). The candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD convergence biconditional is enforced separately, unconditionally, against the real durable ADOS records by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts (the in-office ADOS types cannot represent the validation/review/publish legs). Criteria 19-20 concern the full ADOS validation pipeline and independent Codex review of the Spec 148 IMPLEMENTATION CANDIDATE ITSELF, which the execution policy makes human-only / post-handoff; those are standing ADOS gates re-established against exact candidate HEAD for every candidate and cross-checked from durable ADOS state now by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts (biconditional, both directions) - not a deferred second half of the demonstrated cycle, and never fabricated (section 18).
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion11ExactHeadConvergence: Enforced from the real durable ADOS records (candidate.json / validation-runtime.json / review-runtime.json) by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts: each of candidateMatchesHead / validatedMatchesHead / reviewedMatchesHead is DERIVED with the production comparator (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) against `git rev-parse HEAD`, defaults false, and the convergence biconditional (computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED iff an Approved review is aligned on candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD) runs UNCONDITIONALLY, both directions. Not simulated in-cycle with a hand-built object.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion19FullValidation: ADOS runs the full configured validation set against exact HEAD for every candidate and writes durable validation-runtime.json; production's validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage routes a target mismatch back to fix instead of the human merge gate. When that durable record is a PASS naming exact HEAD, spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts (derived, never a SHA literal) that all six configured commands ran, exited 0, did not time out, and left the worktree unmutated. See dailyProofCycleCompletion.fullConfiguredValidationResult.

dailyProofCycleCompletion.note: The daily-proof test-project cycle (section 3), demonstrated end to end as ONE controlled cycle. The deterministic harness drives Spec 147 -> 145 -> 141 -> 146 -> 144 -> 142/138 -> ADOS execution with the real services; only the ImplementerRuntimeProvider process spawn is the injectable adapter (section 23). After execution the same test resolves the independent reviewer from the run's own durable implementer id (Claude -> distinct Codex, via the real roleResolver.js). The candidate-itself's full configured validation, independent Codex review, and exact-HEAD publication biconditional run in ADOS post-handoff - the in-office ExternalProjectAdosExecution type cannot represent those legs (validationStarted/reviewStarted/publishStarted are typed literal false) - and are enforced UNCONDITIONALLY against the real durable ADOS records (candidate.json / validation-runtime.json / review-runtime.json) by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts, both directions. Terminal completion IS reached in-cycle and is truthful, not fabricated: the ADOS run reports run-level completion (execution.evidence.completed true - distinct from ImplementerRuntimeStatus 'Completed', which is only 'subprocess exited'), production's deriveExternalProjectAdosRunStatus derives run stage 'Completed', the Spec 144 policy's active-execution count drops to 0, and the task reaches 'completed' through the existing operator updateSelectedBacklogTaskFromInput transition. No production code performs an autonomous in_progress -> completed jump and none is added.
dailyProofCycleCompletion.source: real ExternalProjectAdosExecutionService outcome + production deriveExternalProjectAdosRunStatus + real roleResolver.js, exercised by AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts 'completes one controlled Project A cycle end to end' (Tests H, X); the exact-HEAD convergence biconditional against durable ADOS state by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts (real reviewConvergence.js / validationPolicy.js)
dailyProofCycleCompletion.adosRunLevelCompletionSignal: execution.evidence.completed (consumed by ProjectAutonomousExecutionPolicyService / ProjectBacklogReadinessPromotionPolicyService / ProjectAutonomousSuggestionPolicyService countActiveExecutions and OfficeProjectPortalController.isActiveExternalProjectAdosExecution)
dailyProofCycleCompletion.officeObservableDiscriminator: Spec 144 policy active-execution count on the probe (autonomyActiveExecutionCount): 1 while the run is in flight, 0 once evidence.completed is true - asserted in Test X

dailyProofCycleCompletion.terminalTransitionAuthority: existing operator updateSelectedBacklogTaskFromInput path; no autonomous completion path exists in production and Spec 148 adds none
dailyProofCycleCompletion.convergenceBiconditional: spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts, unconditionally and against the real durable ADOS records, that computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED iff an Approved review is aligned on candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD; the negative branch pins the specific non-converged status (IN_PROGRESS for a 'Changes Requested' / trailing-SHA review, NOT_STARTED for a clean checkout) and asserts publicationResult stays a standing 'Blocked until ...' gate.
dailyProofCycleCompletion.fullConfiguredValidationResult: ADOS runs the full configured validation set (npm test, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, npm run test:e2e:home-canvas, git diff --check, git diff --cached --check) against exact HEAD for every candidate and writes durable .agent-workflow/runs/148-.../validation-runtime.json. A standing gate, re-established per candidate, not a frozen snapshot. When that durable record is a PASS naming exact HEAD, spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts DERIVED (never transcribed as a SHA literal) that all six configured commands ran, exited 0, did not time out, and head_before == head_after == candidate_sha == git HEAD. A failed attempt (status BLOCK, e.g. a host-suspension wall-clock timeout) writes the same file with a truncated command list; the test skips the completeness assertion for an explicit BLOCK so it cannot deadlock the next validation.

spec148CandidatePublicationGate.note: How the full ADOS validation pipeline and independent Codex review of the Spec 148 IMPLEMENTATION CANDIDATE ITSELF are enforced. Push, PR readiness, approval, merge, and remote deletion are human-only per the execution policy and are not performed by the implementer runtime. ADOS runs the full configured validation set and an independent Codex review against exact candidate HEAD for every candidate; this tracked artifact deliberately records no publish/merge/deploy verdict because committing it advances HEAD and would immediately stale a frozen verdict - the live per-candidate state lives in the durable .agent-workflow/runs/148-.../{candidate,validation-runtime,review-runtime}.json sources, gated in production by validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage and tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus. spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts enforces the convergence biconditional (candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD + Approved review, both directions) against those durable records unconditionally. The in-office ADOS records cannot represent the publish/merge/deploy legs at all: Spec 130 types validationStarted/reviewStarted/repositoryMutationStarted/githubMutationStarted/publishStarted/mergeStarted/deployStarted as the literal false (src/features/city-view/scene/office/external-ados-execution/ExternalProjectAdosExecutionTypes.ts:41-47, src/features/city-view/scene/office/external-ados-run-status/ExternalProjectAdosRunStatusTypes.ts:29-35); Spec 148 adds no src/ production code (its only production change is an 18-line safety guard in tools/agent-workflow/roleResolver.js, see nonInvocationsVerified), so surfacing publication in-office would require a Spec 130 schema change - an explicit non-goal.
spec148CandidatePublicationGate.criterion19FullValidation: ADOS runs the full configured validation set against exact HEAD for every candidate (see dailyProofCycleCompletion.fullConfiguredValidationResult). When the durable validation-runtime.json is a PASS naming exact HEAD, spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts asserts (derived, never a SHA literal) all six commands ran, exited 0, did not time out, and left the worktree unmutated.
spec148CandidatePublicationGate.criterion20ApprovedReview: The independent Codex review runs against exact candidate HEAD; computeConvergenceStatus reaches CONVERGED only on an Approved review aligned on candidate == validated == reviewed == exact HEAD (spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts, both directions, run unconditionally). Not fabricated here.

shaAlignment.note: Requirement 21 asks for candidate/validated/reviewed SHA 'where available' plus the exact-HEAD result. They are durably available in the sources below and resolved at validation/review time, not transcribed here: a SHA literal committed into a tracked file is stale the moment the commit lands (it changes HEAD). tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts reads those durable sources and runs the convergence biconditional UNCONDITIONALLY: each of candidateMatchesHead / validatedMatchesHead / reviewedMatchesHead defaults to false and is only raised by a present, format-valid, exact-HEAD-aligned durable record, so an absent later-stage record can never silently authorize CONVERGED (the assertion becomes 'must not authorize publication'). Pipeline order candidate -> validate -> review is enforced as a presence rule: review-runtime.json present without validation-runtime.json or candidate.json fails, and validation-runtime.json without candidate.json fails - a selectively-deleted earlier sibling fails, not skips. It does NOT unconditionally assert validated_sha === HEAD, because this suite runs inside `npm test` = validation command #1 and validation-runtime.json naming the current HEAD can only exist after this passes; that leg is a derivation input, and this constraint is stated here rather than hidden in a guard. When candidate.json is present it asserts candidate_sha is exact HEAD (authoritative pipeline: candidate.json is written for the exact commit just before validation) or, during implementation recovery when the implementer commits fixes after that record was written, an ancestor of HEAD (never divergent or ahead) - exact-HEAD strength then carried by the 'must not authorize publication' branch since a trailing candidate makes candidateMatchesHead false. It asserts validation left the worktree unmutated (head_before === head_after), then compares candidate/validated/reviewed targets against exact HEAD with the SAME comparator production uses - validationPolicy.js targetsMatch, reached in production through validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage - and feeds that DERIVED exactTargetMatch plus the REAL durable review decision into computeConvergenceStatus, asserting it converges iff an Approved review is aligned on all three SHAs. On every cycle after the first, review-runtime.json (and briefly validation-runtime.json) still names the prior finished candidate; the derivation then yields exactTargetMatch=false and the assertion is 'must not authorize publication' - a real invariant on both branches, and no self-destruct.
shaAlignment.exactHeadInvariant: ADOS enforces candidateSha == validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD before publication: validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied (validationPolicy.js targetsMatch) at the orchestrateCommand.js final-verification stage routes a target mismatch back to fix instead of the human merge gate, and runSummary.js feeds the same derived value into computeConvergenceStatus as exactTargetMatch. spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts cross-checks the same three durable SHAs with the same targetsMatch comparator against `git rev-parse HEAD`.
shaAlignment.enforcementProvenById: validationPlan.js isFinalValidationSatisfied + validationPolicy.js targetsMatch (production exact-HEAD gate at orchestrateCommand.js final-verification) and tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus; exercised by tools/agent-workflow/spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts including stale-approval rejection, 'converges only when validated == reviewed == exact HEAD', and the durable-source candidate == validated == reviewed cross-check via targetsMatch against exact HEAD

publicationResult: Blocked until ADOS records an Approved independent Codex review with candidateSha == validatedSha == reviewedSha == exact HEAD (tools/agent-workflow/reviewConvergence.js computeConvergenceStatus == CONVERGED). This is the Spec 148 implementation candidate's own publication (spec148CandidatePublicationGate), a human-only / post-handoff step. The convergence biconditional is enforced now, unconditionally, against the real durable ADOS records by spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts; the daily-proof cycle above (dailyProofCycleCompletion) additionally reaches a truthful terminal 'completed' state driven by the real ADOS run-level completion signal. A standing condition, not a per-candidate status snapshot.

failureVisibility.note: Authoritative requirement 18: each stage failure preserves the authoritative prior state, exposes a concise block reason, and does not silently advance / auto-approve / fabricate completion. Deterministic coverage in AutonomousCompanyOperationsE2E.test.ts (suggestion provider, acceptance, ADOS execution stage) and spec148RoleAssignmentEvidence.test.ts (reviewer unavailable, exact-HEAD mismatch).
